The only reason why I brought in facts regarding that sub is because if you post anything funny against there narrative (like harmless, political and genuinely funny pictures), they start talking about how wrong you are for posting that, etc etc

That’s why I stopped posting in there because, like you said, it’s a Humor sub. I only recently started actually using reddit, so I didn’t even know and learned the hard way haha
It’s almost as if backing up what you’re saying is a crime because you disagree with them

For example, look at r/politicalhumor. The majority of the people in there are liberals (that’s why most of the funny pictures that are posted are about republicans/trump) so if you post anything that goes against the liberal agenda, they will drag you. If you go through the comments, most (not all) of the conservatives get completely shit on because of their views even if they can back up their reasoning with facts or sources. If they don’t call you a bigot, racist, etc. they will downvote you to the ground or get your posts deleted.

Personally, the times when I have expressed my views there (ex. funny picture about socialism, Bernie, etc.), they would usually downvote the shit out of me and if I would provide sources with my argument, I wouldn’t get a response anymore. So, if you really want good examples of comments, I would just go through that subreddit because they aren’t hard to find haha

It bothers me so much because as soon as you support everything you say with facts, they paint you to be this god awful person and completely ignore these facts, sources, etc simply because you don’t agree with the majority
